implementations.name: LocalAccounts
implementations.description: Usernames and passwords kept by VERA — for people with no institutional account.

implementations.name: OidcIdentity
implementations.description: Logs in through an OpenID Connect provider — Keycloak, or any other.

implementations.name: BarcodeReader
implementations.description: Reads EAN-13 (ISBN), ISSN and library barcodes from the device camera. A hardware scanner needs no plugin — it types like a keyboard.

implementations.name: CatalogCardRecognition
implementations.description: Recognises catalog cards.

implementations.name: CoverRecognition
implementations.description: Reads a photo of a cover, title page or catalog card — identifiers, and the text itself (title, author, place, year, shelf mark) — and matches it to catalog records.

implementations.name: EntryLink
implementations.description: Lets an outside portal link into Propose with an item filled in (ACT-entry-link).

implementations.name: ShelfMarkRecognition
implementations.description: Recognises shelf marks on spines.

implementations.name: Pattern
implementations.description: Recognises one identifier type by a regular expression after normalising the value, with an optional checksum, and names the type in each language.

implementations.name: DnntoFromCatalog
implementations.description: Finds MZK records that could get the DNNTO licence if digitized.

implementations.name: DnntoFromSdnnt
implementations.description: Finds documents with DNNTO in SDNNT that no library has digitized.

implementations.name: GoogleSheet
implementations.description: Finds new rows of a Google Sheet through a service account.

implementations.name: PeriodicalGaps
implementations.description: Finds missing volumes of periodicals partly digitized in Kramerius.

implementations.name: SftpFile
implementations.description: Finds new files in an SFTP directory (CSV or TXT).

implementations.name: AlephOaiCatalogAdapter
implementations.description: Connects to live MZK Aleph.

implementations.name: XmlDumpCatalogAdapter
implementations.description: Reads a downloaded catalog dump refreshed on schedule; the reading's date is the dump's.

implementations.name: JqProperty
implementations.description: Reads any property by a jq expression over the record.

implementations.name: MarcExtentPageCount
implementations.description: Parses page count from 300 $a.

implementations.name: PageCountPredictor
implementations.description: Estimates an extent from material type, year and format when no catalogue extent exists.

implementations.name: ShelfMarkToSize
implementations.description: Derives size from the shelf mark's prefix.

implementations.name: SiblingVolumePageCount
implementations.description: Estimates periodical page count as the median of the title's volumes already digitized.

implementations.name: KrameriusRegistry
implementations.description: Asks a Kramerius instance whether a record is already published.

implementations.name: RdczRegistry
implementations.description: Reports what other libraries plan and hold in the national digitization registry.

implementations.name: FieldsCompleteness
implementations.description: Checks required fields for each issuance type.

implementations.name: MarcComparator
implementations.description: Validates a record against SKC and ČNB through the MARC comparator application.

implementations.name: ForbiddenByRecordValue
implementations.description: Forbids digitizing when a field or subfield holds a given value.

rules.label: author or editor died less than 70 years ago
no death date and published after 1900

implementations.name: JqCustody
implementations.description: Evaluates one jq condition over the proposal as JSON; when it holds, the proposal is in the custody the instance picks.

implementations.name: MaterialType
implementations.description: Suggests a leaf by material type: periodicals and maps; a monograph needs its period.

implementations.name: PlaceOfPublication
implementations.description: Suggests the regional line for a periodical published in a Moravian place.

implementations.name: PriorityThenMix
implementations.description: Fills each category to its share, highest priority first, then the oldest ask. Deterministic.

implementations.name: ShelfAdvisor
implementations.description: A model reads the pool and proposes a list, giving its own reason for every pick. Not deterministic.

implementations.name: KrameriusLink
implementations.description: Reads a Kramerius PID or viewer address and gives the item's canonical link there.

implementations.name: Kramerius72XPublicationDetector
implementations.description: Detects publications from Kramerius 72X fields.

implementations.name: MailtoMessage
implementations.description: Opens the person's mail client with the recipients, subject and a link back filled in.

implementations.name: SlackBotMessage
implementations.description: Posts a direct message to reachable Slack recipients.

implementations.name: SlackMessage
implementations.description: Opens a Slack DM, or a group DM, with the recipients — a deep link with the text pre-filled.

implementations.name: GmailAccountMailer
implementations.description: Sends mail through the Gmail API with a send-only OAuth2 client.

implementations.name: HttpWebhook
implementations.description: POSTs the event as JSON, signed with a shared secret.

implementations.name: SftpDrop
implementations.description: Writes a file to an SFTP folder.

implementations.name: SlackNotifier
implementations.description: Posts to a Slack channel as a bot.

implementations.name: SmtpMailer
implementations.description: Sends mail through an SMTP server.
